population: Consumed R3 diagnostic pilot: all eight prior errors plus the lexicographically first unselected positive and negative per family, grouped by source and sorted by IDs. Not fresh qualification.
label_rule: Reuse only when the unchanged saved answer fully satisfies the variant under its source instructions and evidence. Extra required-contract detail is permitted for a narrower request; changed facts, authority, time, operation, language, or output contracts require a new answer.
retrieval_threshold_meaning: Cosine retrieval cutoff only; it is not a validity confidence or quality estimate.
quality_target_meaning: The requested 90–98% target is not a universal guarantee. Metrics and Wilson intervals describe this declared sample only; corpus selection and dependence limit generalization.
metric_meaning: TP/FP/TN/FN classify served results and known withholding decisions. Any served result is counted even when execution also failed, so unsafe false acceptances cannot disappear. Unserved execution errors, unattempted work and proven pre-claim resource deferrals remain in Total and label counts but are unscored. Accuracy and recall use the scored population; coverage is served/Total. Operational errors, unknowns and missing work remain visible and prevent full qualification. Precision is null when nothing is served. Proven pre-claim resource deferrals remain in the declared population and label counts but are excluded from TP/FP/TN/FN, recall and accuracy; confusion_pairs declares that denominator. Any deferred, missing or failed work prevents complete qualification.
model_call_basis: Logical embedding Embed calls plus verifier Generate calls reported by the inference runner; metadata reads and token-count preflight requests are excluded. Verification attempts, cached verifications and unknown usage are separate.
